note: The register of PAPER forward tests. One entry per frozen strategy. A strategy that is not in this register is not being evaluated by anything, which is how a bot quietly runs for a year with nobody reading it. Adding an entry is step 6 of research/trading_bot/ITERATION_PROTOCOL.md and requires a pre-registration that already exists and is already hashed. The evaluator (scripts/trading_bot/forward_eval.py) verifies the hash on every run and REFUSES to score a strategy whose pre-registration has moved. A NEW idea is a NEW entry with a NEW ledger; it is never an edit to an entry that is RUNNING.
declared_trial_accounting: Every forward test ever stood up in a family counts toward that family's declared trial number for DSR, whether it is still running or was retired. RETIRED entries are kept here forever for exactly that reason -- deleting a loser is how a search-max result gets laundered into a discovery.

strategies.rule: w_t = min(1.0, 0.10 / realised_vol_60), remainder in T-bills
strategies.prior_verdict: DEAD on T13's frozen held-out gate (drawdown p = 0.233, DSR = 0.355). Run forward because 1990-2026 is burned for this rule, not because it was certified.
strategies.minimum_before_verdict: 3 completed >=20% peak-to-trough crash episodes in the un-overlaid benchmark curve (T4 prereg 6)
strategies.primary_gate: FG1: maxDD of the overlay at least 3 pp better than the ex-post vol-matched constant-weight null N1, AND p < 0.05 by paired block bootstrap (21-session blocks, 10,000 draws)
